safety_semantic_judgments.card_footer: 'Guard collects nothing for {org}' kept org-scoped (not a global 'collects nothing').

safety_semantic_judgments.minimums: Visibility is restricted to at least 5 contributors for totals and 20 for setup-check estimates; report count is per kind and requires at least five senders that day.
safety_semantic_judgments.retentions: Step-by-step timing excludes contents and is kept 14 days. Already sent records retain the 90-day stats/180-day reports distinction; backup removal is within {backup_days} days.
safety_semantic_judgments.never_sent: All six categories remain inside the never-send clause: file paths, commands, prompts, code, model output, and tool arguments.
safety_semantic_judgments.organization_scope: The non-Team footer applies to the named {org}, not every organization, and neither organization admins nor other members can open the report.
safety_semantic_judgments.report_confirmation: Saved locally and not sent; sending is not live yet, and Guard asks the person again before sending to {org}. No automatic send is implied.
safety_semantic_judgments.consent_condition: Widening retains only prior scope until the person chooses; reactivation and lapsed plan require a fresh choice. The prospective sending list is not an unconditional claim.
